points.description: Correct two-state nonlinear model with a valid state choice, e.g. x1 = θ, x2 = θ̇, giving BOTH equations: ẋ1 = x2 and ẋ2 = (1/J)(τ − b x2 − mgℓ sin x1). Equivalent state choices/ordering accepted if both equations are consistent. Both equations needed for full marks.

levels.says: Only one equation correct, or the second equation has a sign/coefficient error, or states defined but equations incomplete.

points.description: Equilibrium condition: x2 = 0 and mgℓ sin θe = τ0 (mgℓ = 1×9.81×0.25 = 2.4525 N·m), and existence range |τ0| ≤ 2.4525 N·m (since |sin θe| ≤ 1). Without the existence range, award 0 for this point.
points.partial_credit: Range as τ0 ≤ 2.4525 without modulus is accepted in full if symmetry (negative torques also allowed) is mentioned anywhere. Claiming a unique equilibrium is not required to be penalised.

levels.says: Range given symbolically as |τ0| ≤ mgℓ without evaluating the number; or range given as τ0 ≤ 2.4525 without modulus and symmetry not mentioned anywhere.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both state equations correct (1) and equilibrium equation with evaluated range |τ0| ≤ 2.4525 N·m (1). Half marks on P2 for the symbolic range or a range missing the modulus without symmetry mentioned. An equilibrium equation with no range earns 0 on P2.
rubric.answer_key: States x1 = θ, x2 = θ̇. ẋ1 = x2; ẋ2 = (1/J)(τ − b x2 − mgℓ sin x1). Equilibrium: ẋ=0 gives x2 = 0 and mgℓ sin θe = τ0, with mgℓ = 1×9.81×0.25 = 2.4525 N·m. Since |sin θe| ≤ 1, an equilibrium exists only for |τ0| ≤ 2.4525 N·m.
